name: Jeffersonville (United States)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the city seal in blue, a compass rose over a river within a ring reading CITY OF JEFFERSONVILLE EST 1802.
history: Jeffersonville is a city in and the county seat of Clark County, Indiana, situated along the Ohio River.
